series.name: Persian OEM-shared 'Super general' table (Fadaktahvieh)
series.notes: Persian Fadaktahvieh table section 'Super general' — F1–F10/FA + E1–E5. OEM-shared lineage (may match other brands) — medium, conflicts with AirChill logged. Brand-badged as Super general section.

meaning.en: Evaporator (indoor coil) temperature sensor fault per this table.
meaning.ur: Is table ke mutabiq evaporator (indoor coil) ka temperature sensor kharab hai.

causes.ur: Sensor open/short ho ya contact zayf ho
Wiring harness kharab

solutions.en: Measure and replace the sensor if out of range
solutions.ur: Multimeter se sensor ki resistance napayin aur range se bahar ho to sensor badal dein

solutions.en: Check connector seating on the board
solutions.ur: Board par lage connector ko check karein ke wo theek baitha hai

notes.en: CONFLICT: Accio says SG E1 = communication. This page's section header claims Super General but codes resemble generic Chinese-OEM boards. Keep isolated.
notes.ur: CONFLICT: Accio ke mutabiq SG E1 = communication. Is page ka section header Super General likha hai lekin codes generic Chinese-OEM boards jaise lagte hain. Ise alag rakhein.

meaning.en: Outdoor unit coil temperature sensor fault.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ke coil ka temperature sensor kharab hai.

causes.ur: Outdoor sensor ka open/short hona
Connector mein zang

solutions.en: Isolate the mains before touching any sensor wiring on the outdoor unit.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit par sensor wiring ko haath lagane se pehle mains ki supply band kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the outdoor coil sensor with a multimeter on resistance; an open, short, or wandering reading means the sensor has failed — replace it with the same type.
solutions.ur: Multimeter ke resistance mode par outdoor coil sensor check karein; open, short ya halki phirti value aaye to sensor kharab ho chuka hai — usi type ka naya sensor lagayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the sensor plug on the outdoor board for dirt or a loose pin, seat it firmly, restore power, and see if E2 clears.
solutions.ur: Outdoor board par lage sensor plug mein gandagi ya dheela pin to nahi ye dekhein, plug theek se lagayein, phir power wapas de kar dekhein ke E2 chala gaya ya nahi.

notes.en: Not present in English SG sources.
notes.ur: English SG sources mein yeh maujood nahi hai.

meaning.en: Evaporator coil temperature sensor fault per this table.
meaning.ur: Is table ke mutabiq evaporator coil ka temperature sensor kharab hai.

causes.ur: Sensor ki reading badal jaye ya circuit open ho
Jaldi barf lagne se coil jam jaye aur reading theek na aaye

solutions.en: Verify sensor resistance and replace if bad
solutions.ur: Sensor ki resistance check karein, kharab ho to naya sensor lagayein

solutions.en: Defrost and clean the indoor coil
solutions.ur: Indoor coil ka defrost karwayein aur saaf karein

notes.ur: CONFLICT: Fixya par model-specific E3 = communication bataya gaya hai (§5.1).

title.ur: Indoor unit ka DC fan motor

meaning.ur: Indoor fan ya DC motor ki kharabi.

causes.ur: Indoor DC fan motor kharab

causes.en: Fan harness or board drive fault
causes.ur: Fan harness ya board ki drive kharab

solutions.en: Check fan connector and motor winding
solutions.ur: Fan ka connector aur motor ki winding multimeter se check karein

solutions.en: Replace indoor fan motor if seized
solutions.ur: Indoor fan motor atka hua ho to use badal dein

notes.en: Partially compatible with AirChill E4 (fan OR frost).
notes.ur: AirChill E4 se aksar mutabiq hai (fan YA frost) — par mukammal nahi.

meaning.en: Table marks E5 as needing specialist attention (intro text ties it to indoor blower communication or board).
meaning.ur: Is table ke mutabiq E5 ke liye expert ki zaroorat hai (intro text ise indoor blower communication ya board se judi karta hai).

causes.en: Indoor blower control or board fault (per intro)
causes.ur: Indoor blower control ya board kharab (intro ke mutabiq)
Zikr nahi hai — table ne mamla technician par chhor diya hai

solutions.en: Do not self-repair; call a specialist
solutions.ur: Khud tamir na karein; expert ko bulayein

solutions.en: Cross-check against English SG sources (compressor overload there)
solutions.ur: English SG sources se mila kar dekhein (wahan compressor overload likha hai)

notes.en: CONFLICT with AirChill E5 = compressor overcurrent.
notes.ur: AirChill E5 = compressor overcurrent se is ka CONFLICT hai.

meaning.en: Inverter power module (IPM) reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter power module (IPM) ne kharabi batayi hai.

causes.ur: IPM ka temperature ya current had se zyada hone par trip hona
Outdoor board ki drive kharab

solutions.en: Stop the unit and service the outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Unit band karein aur outdoor PCB ka service karwayein

solutions.en: Technician-level repair only
solutions.ur: Sirf technician hi is level ki marammat kar sakta hai

notes.en: No English SG source for F-series.
notes.ur: F-series ka koi English SG source nahi mila.

causes.ur: PFC stage par voltage ya current zyad
Outdoor board ka koi component kharab

solutions.en: Switch the unit off and isolate the supply before opening the outdoor panel.
solutions.ur: Outdoor panel kholne se pehle unit band kar ke supply isolate kar dein.

solutions.en: Have a technician measure the DC bus with a meter and look for burnt, bulged, or leaking components around the PFC section of the outdoor board.
solutions.ur: Technician se meter par DC bus check karwayein aur outdoor board ke PFC hisse ke aas paas jale, phoola ya leak hue components dekhein.

solutions.en: Repair or replace the outdoor PCB, and fit a stabilizer if the mains quality is poor, because the fault can return.
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB ka repair ya replacement karwayein, aur agar bijli ki quality kharab hai to stabilizer lagwayein, warna kharabi wapas aa sakti hai.

notes.ur: OEM manual se is ki tasdeeq nahi hui.

causes.ur: Compressor ki drive stage kharab
Compressor ki winding ya wiring mein masla

solutions.en: Technician tests driver and compressor
solutions.ur: Technician driver aur compressor ko khud test karta hai

solutions.en: Replace outdoor PCB if drive is dead
solutions.ur: Agar drive bilkul band ho to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.ur: Yeh baat tasdeeq shuda nahi hai.

meaning.en: Generic temperature-sensor fault per this table.
meaning.ur: Is table ke mutabiq aam temperature sensor kharabi.

causes.en: Any open/short NTC in the system
causes.ur: System mein koi bhi NTC open ya short ho
Connector ki kharabi

solutions.en: Identify which sensor by resistance map, then replace
solutions.ur: Resistance map se tay karein kaun sa sensor kharab hai, phir use badal dein

solutions.en: Verify wiring continuity
solutions.ur: Wiring ki continuity check karein

notes.ur: Yeh baat tasdeeq shuda nahi hai.

meaning.ur: Yahan compressor cover protection likha gaya hai.

causes.ur: Compressor ke aas paas protection switch/sensor
Ziad garmi (overheat) ki surat-e-hal

solutions.en: Turn the unit off and let the compressor cool down before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Unit band kar dein aur kuch haath lagane se pehle compressor ko thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Visually check the protection switch or sensor around the compressor, and clean the outdoor coil so airflow is not blocked.
solutions.ur: Compressor ke aas paas wale protection switch ya sensor ko nazar se dekhein, aur outdoor coil saaf karein taake hawa na ruke.

solutions.en: If protection trips again after the cooldown, call a technician to test the protection circuit and compressor windings with a meter.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad bhi protection dobara trip ho to technician ko bulayein jo meter se protection circuit aur compressor ki winding check kare.

notes.ur: Yeh baat tasdeeq shuda nahi hai.

meaning.en: Outdoor ambient air temperature sensor fault.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient hawa ka temperature sensor kharab hai.

causes.ur: Outdoor ambient NTC kharab ho (open/short)
Dhoop se ya tafseel se sensor kharab

solutions.en: Disconnect the power before checking the sensor wiring outside.
solutions.ur: Bahar ki sensor wiring check karne se pehle power disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the outdoor ambient sensor with a multimeter; an open or short reading means it has to be replaced.
solutions.ur: Outdoor ambient sensor ko multimeter se napayin; open ya short reading aaye to sensor badalna parega.

solutions.en: Check the plug on the ODU board and make sure the sensor is not sun-damaged or loose, then restore power and verify the code clears.
solutions.ur: ODU board par plug check karein aur sensor dhoop se jhansi to nahi ya dheela to nahi, phir power wapas de kar code ke hatne ka tasdeeq karein.

notes.ur: Yeh baat tasdeeq shuda nahi hai.

meaning.ur: Mains voltage allowed range se bahar hai.

causes.ur: Grid par voltage zyaad ya kam
Stabilizer na ho ya kharab ho

solutions.en: Use a stabilizer; verify supply with meter
solutions.ur: Stabilizer lagayein aur multimeter se supply voltage check karein

solutions.en: Retry after power quality improves
solutions.ur: Voltage theek hone par unit ko dobara start karke dekhein

notes.en: Conceptually similar to AirChill 'EL OC' voltage class but different code string.
notes.ur: Fikran AirChill 'EL OC' voltage category jaisa hai lekin code string alag hai.

meaning.en: Communication error involving the outdoor unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit se judi communication kharabi.

causes.ur: Signal wire kharab
ODU board kharab

solutions.en: Isolate the power before handling the inter-unit wiring.
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring haath lagane se pehle power isolate kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the shield and inter-unit wiring end to end for looseness or damage, and re-terminate any loose terminals.
solutions.ur: Shield aur inter-unit wiring ko shuru se end tak dekhein ke kahin dheela ya toota to nahi; dheele terminals dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: If the wiring is fine, a technician should test the communication signal on both boards and replace the outdoor board when the signal is missing.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek hai to technician dono boards par communication signal check kare, aur signal na mile to outdoor board badalwayein.

notes.ur: Yeh baat tasdeeq shuda nahi hai.

title.ur: Outdoor EEPROM kharabi (isi table ke mutabiq)

meaning.en: Outdoor unit EEPROM memory fault according to this table.
meaning.ur: Is table ke mutabiq outdoor unit ki EEPROM memory kharab hai.

causes.ur: EEPROM data kharab
Board ki battery/flash kharab

solutions.en: Power the unit off and stop switching it on and off, because repeated power cycles can worsen the data loss.
solutions.ur: Unit ki power band kar dein aur baar baar on-off na karein, kyunke bar bar power cycle karne se data aur kharab ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: A technician should reflash the EEPROM, and replace the outdoor board if the reflash fails.
solutions.ur: Technician EEPROM ko dobara flash karaye, aur flash na ho sake to outdoor board badalwayein.

solutions.en: After the repair, set the model parameters again and run the unit once to confirm F9 does not return.
solutions.ur: Repair ke baad model ke parameters dobara set karein aur unit ek baar chala kar dekhein ke F9 wapas to nahi aata.

notes.en: DIRECT CONFLICT with Fixya §5.3 F9 = indoor fan motor. Never merge.
notes.ur: Fixya §5.3 mein F9 = indoor fan motor — seedha conflict. Kabhi milayein nahi.

meaning.en: DC fan motor problem per this table.
meaning.ur: Is table ke mutabiq DC fan motor ki masla.

causes.ur: DC fan motor kharab
Fan ka feedback signal milna band ho jana

solutions.en: Switch the power off before checking the fan connector.
solutions.ur: Fan connector check karne se pehle power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the fan connector and wiring, then power on and spin the outdoor fan by hand to confirm it moves freely.
solutions.ur: Fan connector aur wiring check karein, phir power de kar outdoor fan ko haath se ghuma lein ke wo aasani se ghoom raha hai.

solutions.en: If the fan does not run or the feedback signal is missing, replace the DC fan motor and have the technician verify the drive voltage from the board.
solutions.ur: Fan na chale ya feedback signal na mile to DC fan motor badal dein aur technician se board se aane wali drive voltage check karwayein.

notes.ur: Yeh baat tasdeeq shuda nahi hai.

causes.ur: Suction line ka NTC open/short
Sensor ka contact zayf

solutions.en: Isolate the supply before touching the sensor on the suction line.
solutions.ur: Suction line wale sensor ko haath lagane se pehle supply isolate kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor bulb and insulation for damage, and measure the sensor with a meter — replace it if it reads open or short.
solutions.ur: Sensor ke bulb aur insulation ko damage ke liye dekhein, aur meter se sensor check karein — open ya short aaye to badal dein.

solutions.en: Also check the sensor plug on the board for poor contact, then restore power and see if the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Board par sensor ka plug bhi check karein ke contact theek hai ya nahi, phir power wapas de kar dekhein ke kharabi hat gayi ya nahi.

notes.en: Unverified; letter-F code uncommon in English SG sources.
notes.ur: Tasdeeq nahi hui; letter-F code English SG sources mein aam nahi hai.
